# Grow Orbit — Full Agency Knowledge Base & System Documentation

## Overview
Grow Orbit (https://www.groworbitofficial.com) is a full-service Amazon FBA Brand Growth Agency and Consultancy. Founded by e-commerce strategist Coach Ali Haider, Grow Orbit specializes in full account management, Amazon PPC & DSP advertising, CTR-optimized listing image systems, A+ Content (EBC) design, listing SEO copywriting, product sourcing in China, brand launches, and off-Amazon DTC Shopify development.

- **Official Website:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com
- **Core Specialization:** Amazon FBA Scaling, PPC Optimization, Visual Engineering, Product Sourcing.
- **Client Base:** 6-figure and 7-figure Amazon sellers, private label brand owners, and e-commerce enterprises globally.
- **Pricing Model:** Monthly Retainers & Growth-Share / Performance-based options with no long-term lock-in contracts.

---

## Executive Team & Founder
- **Coach Ali Haider (Founder & Lead E-Commerce Strategist):** Expert in Amazon algorithm optimization (A9/Cosmo), direct supplier negotiations in Yiwu & Shenzhen, and high-converting listing graphic design systems.

## Core Services & Operational Capabilities

### 1. Full-Service Amazon FBA Account Management
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/full/amazon-management/
- **Description:** Complete end-to-end account delegation for established brands. Covers daily store operations, inventory forecasting, case management, listing health monitoring, organic SEO, and PPC scaling.

### 2. Amazon PPC Efficiency & DSP Advertising
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/ppc-efficiency/
- **DSP URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/amazon-dsp/
- **Description:** 4-tier advertising architecture designed to reduce ACoS/TACoS while maximizing organic keyword ranking velocity. Includes Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Video, and Amazon DSP programmatic audience retargeting.

### 3. Visual Engineering & Listing Image Design Systems
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/design-creative/
- **Description:** 3D rendered main images, high-conversion lifestyle infographics, Premium A+ Content (EBC) modules, Brand Story carousels, and custom Amazon Brand Storefronts engineered for high Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate (CVR).

### 4. Listing SEO & Copywriting Optimization
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/listing-optimization/
- **Description:** Data-driven keyword research, title engineering, bullet point copywriting, backend search term optimization, and listing audit reports.

### 5. Product Hunting & Sourcing (China Direct)
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/product-hunting-sourcing/
- **Description:** On-the-ground product sourcing, factory audits, sample verification, price negotiations, unit economics modeling, and freight forwarding coordination.

### 6. Brand Launch & Rank Acceleration
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/brand-launch/
- **Description:** Honeymoon period rank acceleration protocols, initial PPC campaign setup, review generation systems, and Page 1 ranking strategies.

### 7. Shopify & DTC Web Development
- **URL:** https://www.groworbitofficial.com/service/dtc-website/
- **Description:** Custom Shopify website design, landing page optimization, and multi-channel sales funnels to diversify revenue off Amazon.
